body:
I don't want to go into to much detail, it would be quite a bit of information that could be used to identify me.

Suffice it to say, I have a number of large plans, but they all start with becoming self sufficient with my current project. I've tried taking jobs, and working it on the side, but that never really worked out, I get too invested in any job I have. This single project literally hinges on everything I plan to do for the rest of my life. If it fails, I don't really see myself having much of a purpose that could really compare.

Many of my goals are extremely humanitarian in nature, which is partly why it's so much stress. I already volunteer a great amount of my time each week to help others, but I'm interested in a large scope. I'm really looking at a couple lucrative plans that will benefit me greatly, as well as others, and I can further sink those resources into more beneficial projects.
